evidence.quote: There were various sweeping statements in the manuscript. For example line 63 which said that patient autonomy was "never considered in prior times". There were also unusual terms used such as in line 92 "non-problem based learning".

We have rephrased the above mentioned sentences. Line 63, now reads as “Patients in the modern era are becoming more and more autonomous, (Shankar & Piryani, 2009) an entity seldom considered in the past but modern medicine cannot advance without incorporating this essential ethical necessity. (Tor, 2001)”
The term non-problem based learning has been clarified in the revised manuscript and it now reads as, “The dominant form of teaching in the medical colleges across the country is conventional consisting of didactic lecture techniques, non-problem-based learning (PBL) teaching methods, long lectures, tutorials and practical tasks ([引文A]).” in line 92.
